activity_summary: You packed two shirts, the hose, the tables, and a quire, and you rolled the lath sword in the grey cloak. The children's things were four separate knots. Mistress Ansell asked whether your wife knows the plot. You said not yet, and that you would tell her the opinion. Alse has never been ten miles. Warwickshire is a hundred. Brooke stays on purpose. Holinshed stays under a cloth, against Gib. The sixty shillings stay in the canvas until tomorrow. The bay is not taken. The long page stays face down.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Packed, promised the opinion, and left both books.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Asked with the quire in her hand, and named tomorrow as the day she counts.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Tied the knots, and measured a hundred miles against the ten she has never travelled.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Sat the cloth, and was not promised a flat one.

facets.activity: Packed the four gifts in separate knots

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Tell her mine opinion of it.
